crm_notes:
Context: mid-market PMS vendor building in-app AI assistant + smart search. Went from PoC on Hosted API -> now sizing Dedicated. Trial run (2 weeks) with ~10 engineers + beta customers. Primary ask: predictable latency (<120ms median per token), cost predictability, VPC and KMS.

Highlights from calls: 
- 2026-02-18 kickoff (FF id ff_2026-02-18_8472): intro, workloads, sample traffic. 
- 2026-03-03 follow-up (FF id ff_2026-03-03_9120): shared logs, token burn summary, asked for Dedicated T-shirt sizing.
- Product quote requested: committed baseline + burst model.

Customer quotes / lines: "Need stable p95 during support hours; can accept higher latency off-hours." 
"We prefer model pinning and clear rollback policy for releases."

POC Observations (hosted trial): 
- Avg daily active end users: 7.4k (beta pool) -> projection to 45k after GA. 
- Feature mix: 55% short assistant prompts (<=120 tokens), 35% search/rerank workflows (embedding + rerank), 10% long-form summarization (>=2k tokens). 
- Latency observed (hosted): median 85ms/token, p95 270ms/token at highest concurrent test. 
- Token consumption: 2.1M tokens/day at beta; projected 12-15M tokens/day at GA with growth assumptions.

Sales notes: agreeable to commit to 12 month reserved Dedicated if pricing per-token equivalent + discounted baseline capacity. Legal: pushing for EU residency for EU customers (data_residency).

Internal shorthand: AE Mariana -> lead, SE Owen -> sizing walkthrough, CSM Priya to own onboarding post-close.

Autoscale policy: add 2 nodes at 30 qps and 4 nodes for sustained peaks near 45 qps. Enable continuous batching for embedding/rerank flows, prefix KV caching for repeated context. Use quantized model variant for cost-sensitive routes; reserve one node for canary/rollout. Estimate monthly baseline cost range in pricing deck (see linked deck).
pricing_discussion_notes: Customer prefers committed baseline + variable burst pricing. Interested in blended per-token pricing that respects on-prem-like residency controls. Asking for 10-20% discount on committed ARR for 12-months. Wants clear overage model and invoice forecasting (monthly).
